    sleap_nn.training.callbacks ¶

    Custom Callback modules for Lightning Trainer.

    Classes:

    Name Description
    AugmentationStageCallback

    Switch the warp dataset's augmentation stage at an epoch or global step.
    BBoxEvaluationCallback

    COCO-style box metrics at the end of validation epochs (bbox_* models).
    BalancedSamplerResume

    Continue the balanced sampler's stream on a resume from an end-of-epoch checkpoint.
    CSVLoggerCallback

    Callback for logging metrics to csv.
    CentroidEvaluationCallback

    Callback to run centroid-specific evaluation metrics at end of validation epochs.
    EmbeddingEvaluationCallback

    Per-epoch retrieval evaluation for the embedding model type.
    EncoderFreezeSchedule

    Freeze part of the model for the first unfreeze_at_step steps.
    EpochEndEvaluationCallback

    Callback to run full evaluation metrics at end of validation epochs.
    EvalCadenceEarlyStopping

    EarlyStopping that checks only on eval epochs, so patience counts evaluations.
    LastEpochCheckpoint

    Write last.ckpt at the end of EVERY epoch.
    MatplotlibSaver

    Callback for saving images rendered with matplotlib during training.
    ProgressReporterZMQ

    Callback to publish training progress events to a ZMQ PUB socket.
    ResumeReseed

    Seed the random generators for the resumed epoch when a run is resumed.
    SegmentationEvaluationCallback

    Per-epoch instance-level mask-IoU evaluation for segmentation models.
    SleapProgressBar

    Custom progress bar with better formatting for small metric values.
    ThroughputMonitor

    Log training speed and input-pipeline stalls every log_every_n_steps.
    TilingEpochCallback

    Propagate the current epoch to the tiling sampler + dataset each epoch.
    TrainingControllerZMQ

    Lightning callback to receive control commands during training via ZMQ.
    UnifiedVizCallback

    Unified callback for all visualization outputs during training.
    ValFile

    One validation labels file, for per-file epoch-end evaluation.
    WandBGalleryCallback

    W&B prediction gallery for box detectors, top-down and bottom-up pose models.
    WandBPredImageLogger

    Callback for writing image predictions to wandb as a Table.
    WandBVizCallback

    Callback for logging visualization images directly to wandb with slider support.
    WandBVizCallbackWithPAFs

    Extended WandBVizCallback that also logs PAF visualizations for bottom-up models.
    WeightEMA

    Exponential moving average (EMA) of the model weights.

    AugmentationStageCallback ¶

    Bases: Callback

    Switch the warp dataset's augmentation stage at an epoch or global step.

    The RTMPose "stage-2 pipeline switch" (mmdet PipelineSwitchHook) for crop_pipeline="warp": from start_epoch (or start_step) on, the training dataset uses its second :class:~sleap_nn.data.topdown_warp.WarpAug (augmentation_config.stage2). mmdet rebuilds the pipeline and restarts the workers; here the dataset holds both stages and reads a shared-memory aug_stage tensor per sample, so persistent workers switch without a restart. The rule is stateless (a function of epoch / step), so resuming from a checkpoint lands in the right stage. Batches prefetched before the switch (at most num_workers * prefetch_factor) still carry stage-1 augmentation.

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    start_epoch

    First (0-based) epoch of stage 2, or None.
    start_step

    First global step of stage 2 (when start_epoch is None).

    class AugmentationStageCallback(Callback):
    """Switch the warp dataset's augmentation stage at an epoch or global step.

    The RTMPose "stage-2 pipeline switch" (mmdet ``PipelineSwitchHook``) for
    ``crop_pipeline="warp"``: from ``start_epoch`` (or ``start_step``) on, the
    training dataset uses its second :class:`~sleap_nn.data.topdown_warp.WarpAug`
    (``augmentation_config.stage2``). mmdet rebuilds the pipeline and restarts the
    workers; here the dataset holds both stages and reads a shared-memory
    ``aug_stage`` tensor per sample, so persistent workers switch without a
    restart. The rule is stateless (a function of epoch / step), so resuming from a
    checkpoint lands in the right stage. Batches prefetched before the switch (at
    most ``num_workers * prefetch_factor``) still carry stage-1 augmentation.

    Attributes:
        start_epoch: First (0-based) epoch of stage 2, or ``None``.
        start_step: First global step of stage 2 (when ``start_epoch`` is ``None``).
    """

    def __init__(
        self, start_epoch: Optional[int] = None, start_step: Optional[int] = None
    ):
        """Initialize with the epoch or step at which stage 2 starts."""
        if start_epoch is None and start_step is None:
            raise ValueError(
                "AugmentationStageCallback needs start_epoch or start_step."
            )
        self.start_epoch = start_epoch
        self.start_step = start_step
        self._stage = None

    def stage_at(self, epoch: int, step: int) -> int:
        """The augmentation stage (0 or 1) at an epoch / global step."""
        if self.start_epoch is not None:
            return int(epoch >= self.start_epoch)
        return int(step >= self.start_step)

    @staticmethod
    def _datasets(trainer):
        for dl in TilingEpochCallback._iter_dataloaders(trainer.train_dataloader):
            ds = getattr(dl, "dataset", None)
            if ds is not None and hasattr(ds, "set_aug_stage"):
                yield ds

    def _sync(self, trainer, step: int) -> None:
        stage = self.stage_at(int(trainer.current_epoch), int(step))
        if stage == self._stage:
            return
        for ds in self._datasets(trainer):
            ds.set_aug_stage(stage)
        if self._stage is not None or stage:
            logger.info(
                f"Augmentation stage {stage + 1} from epoch {trainer.current_epoch}, "
                f"step {step}."
            )
        self._stage = stage

    def on_train_epoch_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Set the stage for this epoch."""
        self._sync(trainer, trainer.global_step)

    def on_train_epoch_end(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Switch before the next epoch's batches are prefetched."""
        if (
            self.start_epoch is not None
            and trainer.current_epoch + 1 >= self.start_epoch
        ):
            for ds in self._datasets(trainer):
                ds.set_aug_stage(1)

    def on_train_batch_start(self, trainer, pl_module, batch, batch_idx):
        """Step-based switch."""
        if self.start_step is not None and self.start_epoch is None:
            self._sync(trainer, trainer.global_step)

    class BBoxEvaluationCallback(Callback):
    """COCO-style box metrics at the end of validation epochs (``bbox_*`` models).

    Turns on the LightningModule's val-time detection collection (detections are
    decoded by the same ``BBoxDecoder`` the predictor uses, down to a low score
    threshold so the precision-recall curve is nearly complete), then scores them
    with :func:`sleap_nn.evaluation.compute_bbox_metrics` and logs
    ``eval/val/bbox_*`` (``mAP`` @[.5:.95], ``AP50``, ``AP75``, ``AR``, and the
    IoU-0.5 best-F1 operating point) to ``callback_metrics`` (CSV log,
    ``ModelCheckpoint``) and wandb, with ``best/`` summaries. Boxes are compared in
    model-input pixels (IoU is scale-invariant).

    Attributes:
        eval_frequency: Run evaluation every N epochs.
    """

    # Lower-is-better keys (counts of errors); everything else is higher-is-better.
    _LOWER_IS_BETTER = ("bbox_n_fp", "bbox_n_fn", "bbox_false_per_frame")

    def __init__(self, eval_frequency: int = 1, cover_metrics: bool = False):
        """Initialize the callback."""
        super().__init__()
        self.eval_frequency = eval_frequency
        self.cover_metrics = cover_metrics

    def on_validation_epoch_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Enable detection collection on scored epochs (not the sanity check)."""
        if trainer.sanity_checking:
            return
        # Decoding every val batch costs time; only collect when this epoch scores.
        pl_module._collect_val_predictions = (
            trainer.current_epoch + 1
        ) % self.eval_frequency == 0

    def on_validation_epoch_end(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Score the collected detections and log the metrics."""
        from sleap_nn.evaluation import (
            BBOX_COVER_LOG_KEYS,
            BBOX_EVAL_LOG_KEYS,
            compute_bbox_cover_metrics,
            compute_bbox_metrics,
        )

        scored = (
            trainer.current_epoch + 1
        ) % self.eval_frequency == 0 and not trainer.sanity_checking
        gts, preds = pl_module.val_ground_truth, pl_module.val_predictions
        if scored:
            gts, preds = self._gather(trainer, gts, preds)
        metrics = None
        if scored and trainer.is_global_zero:
            if not gts:
                logger.warning("No detections collected for bbox epoch-end evaluation")
            else:
                try:
                    frames = [{**gt, **pred} for gt, pred in zip(gts, preds)]
                    # Ignore boxes (experimental): the loss's ignore rule.
                    rule = getattr(pl_module, "ignore_metric_rule", None) or {}
                    metrics = compute_bbox_metrics(
                        frames,
                        num_classes=len(pl_module.categories),
                        max_detections=pl_module.decoder.max_detections,
                        **rule,
                    )
                    if self.cover_metrics:
                        metrics.update(compute_bbox_cover_metrics(frames, **rule))
                    logger.info(
                        f"Epoch {trainer.current_epoch} bbox evaluation: "
                        f"mAP={metrics['bbox_mAP']:.4f}, "
                        f"AP50={metrics['bbox_AP50']:.4f}, "
                        f"F1@0.5={metrics['bbox_f1']:.4f}"
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    metrics = None
                    logger.warning(f"Bbox epoch-end evaluation failed: {e}")
        if scored:
            # `ModelCheckpoint` / `EarlyStopping` run on every rank and may monitor a
            # box metric (`eval.select_metric`); the checkpointer raises on a missing
            # monitor, so every rank gets rank 0's values, even after a failed eval.
            values = None
            if metrics is not None:
                keys = BBOX_EVAL_LOG_KEYS + (
                    BBOX_COVER_LOG_KEYS if self.cover_metrics else ()
                )
                values = {key: metrics.get(key) for key in keys}
            values = trainer.strategy.broadcast(values, src=0)
            self._log_metrics(trainer, values or {}, trainer.current_epoch)

        # Every rank clears its own lists (they only fill on scored epochs).
        pl_module._collect_val_predictions = False
        pl_module.val_predictions = []
        pl_module.val_ground_truth = []
        trainer.strategy.barrier()

    @staticmethod
    def _gather(trainer, gts: list, preds: list):
        """All ranks' val detections (DDP shards the val set), de-duplicated.

        A collective: every rank must call it. The distributed sampler pads the
        last shard by repeating frames, so frames are kept once by
        ``(video_idx, frame_idx)``. A single process returns its own lists.
        """
        import torch.distributed as dist

        if not (dist.is_available() and dist.is_initialized()) or (
            trainer.world_size <= 1
        ):
            return gts, preds
        gathered = [None] * trainer.world_size
        dist.all_gather_object(gathered, (gts, preds))
        seen, out_gts, out_preds = set(), [], []
        for rank_gts, rank_preds in gathered:
            for gt, pred in zip(rank_gts, rank_preds):
                key = (gt["video_idx"], gt["frame_idx"])
                if key not in seen:
                    seen.add(key)
                    out_gts.append(gt)
                    out_preds.append(pred)
        return out_gts, out_preds

    def _log_metrics(self, trainer, metrics: dict, epoch: int):
        """Expose metrics to callback_metrics (every rank) and log them to wandb.

        Every ``BBOX_EVAL_LOG_KEYS`` key lands in ``callback_metrics``; a missing or
        NaN value becomes the metric's worst value, so a monitored key never goes
        missing and a failed evaluation is never selected as best.
        """
        import numpy as np
        import torch
        from lightning.pytorch.loggers import WandbLogger
        from sleap_nn.evaluation import BBOX_COVER_LOG_KEYS, BBOX_EVAL_LOG_KEYS

        log_dict = {}
        keys = BBOX_EVAL_LOG_KEYS + (BBOX_COVER_LOG_KEYS if self.cover_metrics else ())
        for key in keys:
            raw_value = metrics.get(key, float("nan"))
            lower_is_better = key in self._LOWER_IS_BETTER
            if raw_value is None or np.isnan(raw_value):
                fv = float("inf") if lower_is_better else 0.0
            else:
                fv = float(raw_value)
                log_dict[f"eval/val/{key}"] = fv
            trainer.callback_metrics[f"eval/val/{key}"] = torch.as_tensor(fv)

        wandb_logger = next(
            (log for log in trainer.loggers if isinstance(log, WandbLogger)), None
        )
        if wandb_logger is None or not trainer.is_global_zero or not log_dict:
            return
        wandb_logger.experiment.log({"epoch": epoch, **log_dict}, commit=False)
        summary = wandb_logger.experiment.summary
        for key, value in log_dict.items():
            if key.endswith("_threshold"):
                continue
            summary_key = f"best/{key}"
            current = summary.get(summary_key)
            better = (
                (
                    value < current
                    if key.split("/")[-1] in self._LOWER_IS_BETTER
                    else value > current
                )
                if current is not None
                else True
            )
            if better:
                summary[summary_key] = value

    def on_validation_epoch_end(self, trainer, pl_module):
    """Score the collected detections and log the metrics."""
    from sleap_nn.evaluation import (
        BBOX_COVER_LOG_KEYS,
        BBOX_EVAL_LOG_KEYS,
        compute_bbox_cover_metrics,
        compute_bbox_metrics,
    )

    scored = (
        trainer.current_epoch + 1
    ) % self.eval_frequency == 0 and not trainer.sanity_checking
    gts, preds = pl_module.val_ground_truth, pl_module.val_predictions
    if scored:
        gts, preds = self._gather(trainer, gts, preds)
    metrics = None
    if scored and trainer.is_global_zero:
        if not gts:
            logger.warning("No detections collected for bbox epoch-end evaluation")
        else:
            try:
                frames = [{**gt, **pred} for gt, pred in zip(gts, preds)]
                # Ignore boxes (experimental): the loss's ignore rule.
                rule = getattr(pl_module, "ignore_metric_rule", None) or {}
                metrics = compute_bbox_metrics(
                    frames,
                    num_classes=len(pl_module.categories),
                    max_detections=pl_module.decoder.max_detections,
                    **rule,
                )
                if self.cover_metrics:
                    metrics.update(compute_bbox_cover_metrics(frames, **rule))
                logger.info(
                    f"Epoch {trainer.current_epoch} bbox evaluation: "
                    f"mAP={metrics['bbox_mAP']:.4f}, "
                    f"AP50={metrics['bbox_AP50']:.4f}, "
                    f"F1@0.5={metrics['bbox_f1']:.4f}"
                )
            except Exception as e:
                metrics = None
                logger.warning(f"Bbox epoch-end evaluation failed: {e}")
    if scored:
        # `ModelCheckpoint` / `EarlyStopping` run on every rank and may monitor a
        # box metric (`eval.select_metric`); the checkpointer raises on a missing
        # monitor, so every rank gets rank 0's values, even after a failed eval.
        values = None
        if metrics is not None:
            keys = BBOX_EVAL_LOG_KEYS + (
                BBOX_COVER_LOG_KEYS if self.cover_metrics else ()
            )
            values = {key: metrics.get(key) for key in keys}
        values = trainer.strategy.broadcast(values, src=0)
        self._log_metrics(trainer, values or {}, trainer.current_epoch)

    # Every rank clears its own lists (they only fill on scored epochs).
    pl_module._collect_val_predictions = False
    pl_module.val_predictions = []
    pl_module.val_ground_truth = []
    trainer.strategy.barrier()

    def on_validation_epoch_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
    """Enable detection collection on scored epochs (not the sanity check)."""
    if trainer.sanity_checking:
        return
    # Decoding every val batch costs time; only collect when this epoch scores.
    pl_module._collect_val_predictions = (
        trainer.current_epoch + 1
    ) % self.eval_frequency == 0

    BalancedSamplerResume ¶

    Bases: Callback

    Continue the balanced sampler's stream on a resume from an end-of-epoch checkpoint.

    :class:~sleap_nn.data.topdown_warp.BalancedDataLoader saves the number of batches it has delivered in every checkpoint (Lightning stores a train loader's state_dict with the fit loop), but Lightning loads it back only from a checkpoint written in the middle of an epoch (or with max_steps set). last.ckpt and best.ckpt are written once an epoch is over, so a run resumed from them started the stream over and trained on the first epochs' batches again. This loads the saved state at the start of training in that case too. It is the state Lightning itself loads from a mid-epoch checkpoint, so doing both changes nothing, and without a resume this does nothing.

    class BalancedSamplerResume(Callback):
    """Continue the balanced sampler's stream on a resume from an end-of-epoch checkpoint.

    :class:`~sleap_nn.data.topdown_warp.BalancedDataLoader` saves the number of
    batches it has delivered in every checkpoint (Lightning stores a train loader's
    ``state_dict`` with the fit loop), but Lightning loads it back only from a
    checkpoint written in the middle of an epoch (or with ``max_steps`` set).
    ``last.ckpt`` and ``best.ckpt`` are written once an epoch is over, so a run
    resumed from them started the stream over and trained on the first epochs'
    batches again. This loads the saved state at the start of training in that
    case too. It is the state Lightning itself loads from a mid-epoch checkpoint,
    so doing both changes nothing, and without a resume this does nothing.
    """

    def __init__(self):
        """Initialize with no state to restore."""
        super().__init__()
        self._states = None

    def on_load_checkpoint(self, trainer, pl_module, checkpoint) -> None:
        """Keep the train loader states saved with the checkpoint's fit loop."""
        fit_loop = checkpoint.get("loops", {}).get("fit_loop", {})
        self._states = fit_loop.get("state_dict", {}).get("combined_loader")

    def on_train_start(self, trainer, pl_module) -> None:
        """Load the saved states (before the first batch is drawn)."""
        from sleap_nn.data.topdown_warp import BalancedDataLoader

        states, self._states = self._states, None
        if not states:
            return
        loaders = [
            dl
            for dl in TilingEpochCallback._iter_dataloaders(trainer.train_dataloader)
            if isinstance(dl, BalancedDataLoader)
        ]
        if len(loaders) != len(states):
            return
        for dl, state in zip(loaders, states):
            dl.load_state_dict(state)

    def on_train_start(self, trainer, pl_module) -> None:
    """Load the saved states (before the first batch is drawn)."""
    from sleap_nn.data.topdown_warp import BalancedDataLoader

    states, self._states = self._states, None
    if not states:
        return
    loaders = [

    if len(loaders) != len(states):
        return
    for dl, state in zip(loaders, states):
        dl.load_state_dict(state)

    class CSVLoggerCallback(Callback):
    """Callback for logging metrics to csv.

    One row is written per training epoch that ran validation, holding that
    epoch's train loss/LR (logged in ``LightningModule.on_train_epoch_end``)
    and its latest validation and eval metrics.

    Lightning runs the epoch-end validation loop *before*
    ``on_train_epoch_end``, so a row written at the end of validation would
    carry the previous epoch's ``train/loss`` and ``train/lr``. The row is
    therefore marked pending when validation ends and written once the epoch's
    train metrics have been logged: at the start of the next train epoch, or
    at the end of training for the last one.

    Attributes:
        filepath: Path to save the csv file.
        keys: List of field names to be logged in the csv.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        filepath: Path,
        keys: list = ["epoch", "train_loss", "val_loss", "learning_rate"],
    ):
        """Initialize attributes."""
        super().__init__()
        self.filepath = filepath
        self.keys = keys
        self.initialized = False
        # Epoch whose row is waiting for its train metrics (see class docstring).
        self._pending_epoch = None

    def _init_file(self):
        """Create the .csv file."""
        if RANK in [0, -1]:  # Global rank 0 or -1 (non-distributed)
            self.filepath.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            with open(self.filepath, "w", newline="") as f:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=self.keys)
                writer.writeheader()
        self.initialized = True

    def on_validation_epoch_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Reset eval-callback keys to NaN before this epoch's eval callback runs.

        EpochEndEvaluationCallback / SegmentationEvaluationCallback /
        CentroidEvaluationCallback only write their ``eval/val/*`` keys into
        ``trainer.callback_metrics`` on epochs gated by ``eval_frequency``, and
        Lightning never clears ``callback_metrics`` between epochs (it's reset
        once at the start of ``fit()``, not per-epoch). Without this reset, a
        non-eval epoch's CSV row would silently repeat the last-computed eval
        value instead of showing that eval did not run this epoch.
        """
        if trainer.sanity_checking:
            return
        import torch

        for key in self.keys:
            if key.startswith("eval/"):
                trainer.callback_metrics[key] = torch.tensor(float("nan"))

    def on_validation_end(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Mark this epoch's row as pending.

        Runs on ``on_validation_end`` (not ``on_validation_epoch_end``) so it
        comes *after* every callback's ``on_validation_epoch_end`` hook --
        including the eval callbacks -- regardless of callback registration
        order. The row itself is written by :meth:`_write_pending_row` once the
        epoch's train metrics exist.
        """
        if trainer.sanity_checking:
            return
        self._pending_epoch = trainer.current_epoch

    def on_train_epoch_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Write the previous epoch's row (its train metrics are logged now)."""
        self._write_pending_row(trainer)

    def on_train_end(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Write the last epoch's row."""
        self._write_pending_row(trainer)

    def _write_pending_row(self, trainer):
        """Append the pending epoch's row, if any, to the csv."""
        if self._pending_epoch is None:
            return
        epoch, self._pending_epoch = self._pending_epoch, None
        # Access callback_metrics BEFORE the is_global_zero guard so all
        # ranks participate in the implicit all_reduce that fires when
        # sync_dist=True metrics are first read.  Only rank 0 does I/O.
        metrics = trainer.callback_metrics
        if trainer.is_global_zero:
            if not self.initialized:
                self._init_file()
            log_data = {}
            for key in self.keys:
                if key == "epoch":
                    log_data["epoch"] = epoch
                elif key == "learning_rate":
                    # Handle multiple formats:
                    # 1. Direct "learning_rate" key
                    # 2. "train/lr" key (current format from lightning modules)
                    # 3. "lr-*" keys from LearningRateMonitor (legacy)
                    value = metrics.get(key, None)
                    if value is None:
                        value = metrics.get("train/lr", None)
                    if value is None:
                        # Look for lr-* keys from LearningRateMonitor (legacy)
                        for metric_key in metrics.keys():
                            if metric_key.startswith("lr-"):
                                value = metrics[metric_key]
                                break
                    log_data[key] = value.item() if value is not None else None
                else:
                    value = metrics.get(key, None)
                    log_data[key] = value.item() if value is not None else None

            with open(self.filepath, "a", newline="") as f:
                writer = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=self.keys)
                writer.writerow(log_data)

        # Sync all processes after file I/O
        trainer.strategy.barrier()

    CentroidEvaluationCallback ¶

    Bases: Callback

    Callback to run centroid-specific evaluation metrics at end of validation epochs.

    This callback is designed specifically for centroid models, which predict a single point (centroid) per instance rather than full pose skeletons. It computes distance-based metrics and detection metrics that are more appropriate for point detection tasks than OKS/PCK metrics.

    Metrics computed
    • Distance metrics: mean, median, p90, p95, max Euclidean distance
    • Detection metrics: precision, recall, F1 score
    • Counts: true positives, false positives, false negatives

    Attributes:

    Name Type Description
    videos

    List of sio.Video objects.
    eval_frequency

    Run evaluation every N epochs (default: 1).
    match_threshold

    Maximum distance (pixels) for matching pred to GT (default: 50.0).

    class CentroidEvaluationCallback(Callback):
    """Callback to run centroid-specific evaluation metrics at end of validation epochs.

    This callback is designed specifically for centroid models, which predict a single
    point (centroid) per instance rather than full pose skeletons. It computes
    distance-based metrics and detection metrics that are more appropriate for
    point detection tasks than OKS/PCK metrics.

    Metrics computed:
        - Distance metrics: mean, median, p90, p95, max Euclidean distance
        - Detection metrics: precision, recall, F1 score
        - Counts: true positives, false positives, false negatives

    Attributes:
        videos: List of sio.Video objects.
        eval_frequency: Run evaluation every N epochs (default: 1).
        match_threshold: Maximum distance (pixels) for matching pred to GT (default: 50.0).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        videos: list,
        eval_frequency: int = 1,
        match_threshold: float = 50.0,
    ):
        """Initialize the callback.

        Args:
            videos: List of sio.Video objects.
            eval_frequency: Run evaluation every N epochs (default: 1).
            match_threshold: Maximum distance in pixels for a prediction to be
                considered a match to a ground truth centroid (default: 50.0).
        """
        super().__init__()
        self.videos = videos
        self.eval_frequency = eval_frequency
        self.match_threshold = match_threshold

    def on_validation_epoch_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Enable prediction collection on scored epochs (not the sanity check)."""
        if trainer.sanity_checking:
            return
        pl_module._collect_val_predictions = _is_eval_epoch(
            trainer, self.eval_frequency
        )

    def on_validation_epoch_end(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Run centroid evaluation and log metrics at end of validation epoch.

        Under DDP every rank's val shard is gathered, rank 0 scores the whole val
        set, and its metrics are broadcast so every rank's checkpointer sees them.
        """
        import numpy as np

        scored = _is_eval_epoch(trainer, self.eval_frequency)
        gts, preds = pl_module.val_ground_truth, pl_module.val_predictions
        metrics = None
        if scored:
            gts, preds = _gather_val_entries(trainer, gts, preds)
        if scored and trainer.is_global_zero:
            if not preds or not gts:
                logger.warning(
                    "No predictions collected for centroid epoch-end evaluation"
                )
            else:
                try:
                    metrics = self._compute_metrics(preds, gts, np)
                    logger.info(
                        f"Epoch {trainer.current_epoch} centroid evaluation: "
                        f"precision={metrics['precision']:.4f}, "
                        f"recall={metrics['recall']:.4f}, "
                        f"dist_avg={metrics['dist_avg']:.2f}px"
                    )
                except Exception as e:
                    metrics = None
                    logger.warning(f"Centroid epoch-end evaluation failed: {e}")
        if scored:
            metrics = trainer.strategy.broadcast(metrics, src=0)
            self._log_metrics(trainer, metrics or {}, trainer.current_epoch)

        # Every rank clears its own lists (they only fill on scored epochs).
        pl_module._collect_val_predictions = False
        pl_module.val_predictions = []
        pl_module.val_ground_truth = []

        # Sync all processes - barrier must be reached by ALL ranks
        trainer.strategy.barrier()

    def _compute_metrics(self, predictions: list, ground_truth: list, np) -> dict:
        """Compute centroid-specific metrics.

        Args:
            predictions: List of prediction dicts with "pred_peaks" key.
            ground_truth: List of ground truth dicts with "gt_instances" key.
            np: NumPy module.

        Returns:
            Dictionary of computed metrics.
        """
        all_distances = []
        total_tp = 0
        total_fp = 0
        total_fn = 0

        # Group predictions and GT by frame
        pred_by_frame = {}
        for pred in predictions:
            key = (pred["video_idx"], pred["frame_idx"])
            if key not in pred_by_frame:
                pred_by_frame[key] = []
            # pred_peaks shape: (n_inst, 1, 2) -> extract centroids as (n_inst, 2)
            centroids = pred["pred_peaks"].reshape(-1, 2)
            # Filter out NaN centroids
            valid_mask = ~np.isnan(centroids).any(axis=1)
            pred_by_frame[key].append(centroids[valid_mask])

        gt_by_frame = {}
        for gt in ground_truth:
            key = (gt["video_idx"], gt["frame_idx"])
            if key not in gt_by_frame:
                gt_by_frame[key] = []
            # gt_instances shape: (n_inst, 1, 2) -> extract centroids as (n_inst, 2)
            centroids = gt["gt_instances"].reshape(-1, 2)
            # Filter out NaN centroids
            valid_mask = ~np.isnan(centroids).any(axis=1)
            gt_by_frame[key].append(centroids[valid_mask])

        # Process each frame
        all_frames = set(pred_by_frame.keys()) | set(gt_by_frame.keys())
        for frame_key in all_frames:
            # Concatenate all predictions for this frame
            if frame_key in pred_by_frame:
                frame_preds = np.concatenate(pred_by_frame[frame_key], axis=0)
            else:
                frame_preds = np.zeros((0, 2))

            # Concatenate all GT for this frame
            if frame_key in gt_by_frame:
                frame_gt = np.concatenate(gt_by_frame[frame_key], axis=0)
            else:
                frame_gt = np.zeros((0, 2))

            # Match predictions to ground truth
            matched_pred, matched_gt, unmatched_pred, unmatched_gt = match_centroids(
                frame_preds, frame_gt, max_distance=self.match_threshold
            )

            # Compute distances for matched pairs
            if len(matched_pred) > 0:
                matched_pred_points = frame_preds[matched_pred]
                matched_gt_points = frame_gt[matched_gt]
                distances = np.linalg.norm(
                    matched_pred_points - matched_gt_points, axis=1
                )
                all_distances.extend(distances.tolist())

            # Update counts
            total_tp += len(matched_pred)
            total_fp += len(unmatched_pred)
            total_fn += len(unmatched_gt)

        # Compute aggregate metrics
        all_distances = np.array(all_distances)

        # Distance metrics (only if we have matches)
        if len(all_distances) > 0:
            dist_avg = float(np.mean(all_distances))
            dist_median = float(np.median(all_distances))
            dist_p90 = float(np.percentile(all_distances, 90))
            dist_p95 = float(np.percentile(all_distances, 95))
            dist_max = float(np.max(all_distances))
        else:
            dist_avg = dist_median = dist_p90 = dist_p95 = dist_max = float("nan")

        # Detection metrics
        precision = (
            total_tp / (total_tp + total_fp) if (total_tp + total_fp) > 0 else 0.0
        )
        recall = total_tp / (total_tp + total_fn) if (total_tp + total_fn) > 0 else 0.0
        f1 = (
            2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
            if (precision + recall) > 0
            else 0.0
        )

        return {
            "dist_avg": dist_avg,
            "dist_median": dist_median,
            "dist_p90": dist_p90,
            "dist_p95": dist_p95,
            "dist_max": dist_max,
            "precision": precision,
            "recall": recall,
            "f1": f1,
            "n_true_positives": total_tp,
            "n_false_positives": total_fp,
            "n_false_negatives": total_fn,
            "n_total_predictions": total_tp + total_fp,
            "n_total_ground_truth": total_tp + total_fn,
        }

    def _log_metrics(self, trainer, metrics: dict, epoch: int):
        """Populate callback_metrics for ModelCheckpoint, then log to WandB.

        Runs on every rank; wandb logging happens on rank 0 only. An empty
        ``metrics`` (a failed or empty evaluation) sets every key to its worst value.
        """
        import numpy as np
        import torch
        from lightning.pytorch.loggers import WandbLogger

        # (callback/wandb key, raw value, higher_is_better)
        tracked = [
            ("eval/val/centroid_dist_avg", metrics.get("dist_avg"), False),
            ("eval/val/centroid_dist_median", metrics.get("dist_median"), False),
            ("eval/val/centroid_dist_p90", metrics.get("dist_p90"), False),
            ("eval/val/centroid_dist_p95", metrics.get("dist_p95"), False),
            ("eval/val/centroid_dist_max", metrics.get("dist_max"), False),
            ("eval/val/centroid_precision", metrics.get("precision"), True),
            ("eval/val/centroid_recall", metrics.get("recall"), True),
            ("eval/val/centroid_f1", metrics.get("f1"), True),
            ("eval/val/centroid_n_tp", metrics.get("n_true_positives"), True),
            ("eval/val/centroid_n_fp", metrics.get("n_false_positives"), True),
            ("eval/val/centroid_n_fn", metrics.get("n_false_negatives"), True),
        ]

        # Expose every metric to ModelCheckpoint/EarlyStopping via
        # callback_metrics (mirrors EpochEndEvaluationCallback -- see its
        # _log_metrics for the full rationale). ALWAYS populate the key: a
        # NaN/missing distance metric (no matched instances this epoch) falls
        # back to +inf (the worst value for a lower-is-better pixel distance)
        # instead of leaving the key unset, which would crash ModelCheckpoint
        # on the first epoch a run monitors it.
        for ck_key, raw_value, higher_is_better in tracked:
            worst = 0.0 if higher_is_better else float("inf")
            fv = (
                worst
                if (raw_value is None or np.isnan(raw_value))
                else float(raw_value)
            )
            trainer.callback_metrics[ck_key] = torch.as_tensor(fv)

        wandb_logger = None
        for log in trainer.loggers:
            if isinstance(log, WandbLogger):
                wandb_logger = log
                break

        if wandb_logger is None or not trainer.is_global_zero:
            return

        log_dict = {"epoch": epoch}
        for ck_key, raw_value, _higher_is_better in tracked:
            if raw_value is not None and not np.isnan(raw_value):
                log_dict[ck_key] = raw_value

        wandb_logger.experiment.log(log_dict, commit=False)

        # Update best metrics in summary
        for key, value in log_dict.items():
            if key == "epoch":
                continue
            summary_key = f"best/{key}"
            current_best = wandb_logger.experiment.summary.get(summary_key)
            # For distance metrics, lower is better; for others, higher is better
            is_distance = "dist" in key
            if current_best is None:
                wandb_logger.experiment.summary[summary_key] = value
            elif is_distance and value < current_best:
                wandb_logger.experiment.summary[summary_key] = value
            elif not is_distance and value > current_best:
                wandb_logger.experiment.summary[summary_key] = value

    class EmbeddingEvaluationCallback(Callback):
    """Per-epoch retrieval evaluation for the ``embedding`` model type.

    Mirrors :class:`SegmentationEvaluationCallback`'s lifecycle: flips
    ``pl_module._collect_val_predictions`` on at validation start so the embedding
    ``validation_step`` collects per-crop ``{"embedding": vec}`` + ``{"label": id}``,
    then computes retrieval (rank-1 / mAP), verification (ROC-AUC / EER) and cosine-kNN
    accuracy over the val set (leave-self-out gallery == query; see
    :func:`sleap_nn.evaluation.embedding_leave_self_out_eval`). Crops whose identity
    has no other val crop are not scored; their count goes to wandb as
    ``eval/val/n_no_positive_queries``.

    Crucially it logs the selected metric BOTH via ``pl_module.log`` (so it lands in
    ``trainer.callback_metrics`` for ``ModelCheckpoint`` / ``EarlyStopping`` to select
    on a retrieval metric, NOT ``val/loss``) AND to wandb. The selection scalar is
    broadcast from rank 0 so every rank logs the same value (no DDP deadlock).

    Attributes:
        eval_frequency: Run evaluation every N epochs (default: 1).
        knn_k: k for the cosine-kNN accuracy.
        last_val_embeddings: The latest validation pass's embeddings (rank 0), which
            the embedding scatter viz reuses.
    """

    def __init__(self, eval_frequency: int = 1, knn_k: int = 7):
        """Initialize the callback.

        It logs every selection metric (rank1 / mAP / auc / eer / knn_acc); which one
        ModelCheckpoint and EarlyStopping monitor is ``trainer_config.eval.select_metric``.
        """
        super().__init__()
        self.eval_frequency = eval_frequency
        self.knn_k = knn_k
        # Last successfully computed metrics, re-logged on epochs that do not
        # evaluate so the monitored key is never ABSENT from
        # ``trainer.callback_metrics``. `ModelCheckpoint` raises
        # `MisconfigurationException: could not find the monitored key` the first
        # time it looks for a key that was never logged -- which, with
        # `eval.frequency > 1`, is the end of epoch 0.
        self._last_metrics = None
        # The val embeddings of the latest validation pass, as
        # ``{"epoch", "embedding" (N, D) float32, "label" (N,)}`` (rank 0 only). The
        # embedding scatter (`UnifiedVizCallback`) plots these instead of decoding and
        # embedding the val crops a second time.
        self.last_val_embeddings = None

    def _get_wandb_logger(self, trainer):
        from lightning.pytorch.loggers import WandbLogger

        for log in trainer.loggers:
            if isinstance(log, WandbLogger):
                return log
        return None

    def on_validation_epoch_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Enable per-crop embedding collection on rank 0 (skip sanity check).

        Only rank 0 computes the metrics, and every rank runs the full val set (the
        embedding val loader is not sharded), so collecting on other ranks would only
        accumulate crops that nothing reads.
        """
        if trainer.sanity_checking:
            return
        pl_module._collect_val_predictions = bool(trainer.is_global_zero)

    @staticmethod
    def _stack_collected(predictions: list, ground_truth: list):
        """The collected per-crop dicts as ``(embeddings (N, D), labels (N,))``."""
        import numpy as np

        emb = np.stack([p["embedding"].numpy() for p in predictions])
        y = np.asarray([g["label"] for g in ground_truth])
        return emb, y

    def _compute_metrics(self, emb, y) -> dict:
        """Leave-self-out retrieval/verification/kNN over the collected val embeddings.

        Delegates to :func:`sleap_nn.evaluation.embedding_leave_self_out_eval` so the
        per-epoch selection metric and the post-training headline (train.py) use the
        exact same protocol.
        """
        from sleap_nn.evaluation import embedding_leave_self_out_eval

        return embedding_leave_self_out_eval(emb, y, k=self.knn_k)

    def on_validation_epoch_end(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Compute retrieval metrics; log to callback_metrics (selection) + wandb."""
        # Nothing is collected during the sanity pass (see on_validation_epoch_start),
        # so evaluating there would only warn about an empty val set.
        should_evaluate = (
            (trainer.current_epoch + 1) % self.eval_frequency == 0
            and trainer.is_global_zero
            and not trainer.sanity_checking
        )

        collected = None
        if (
            trainer.is_global_zero
            and not trainer.sanity_checking
            and pl_module.val_predictions
            and pl_module.val_ground_truth
        ):
            # Rank 0 must reach the broadcasts below whatever happens here, or every
            # other rank waits on them; a failure only skips this epoch's eval.
            try:
                collected = self._stack_collected(
                    pl_module.val_predictions, pl_module.val_ground_truth
                )
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Could not stack the val embeddings: {e}")
            else:
                self.last_val_embeddings = {
                    "epoch": trainer.current_epoch,
                    "embedding": collected[0],
                    "label": collected[1],
                }

        metrics = None
        if should_evaluate:
            if collected is None:
                logger.warning("No embeddings collected for embedding evaluation.")
            else:
                try:
                    metrics = self._compute_metrics(*collected)
                    n_no_positive = metrics.get("n_no_positive_queries", 0)
                    logger.info(
                        f"Epoch {trainer.current_epoch} embedding eval: "
                        f"rank1={metrics['rank1']:.4f} mAP={metrics['mAP']:.4f} "
                        f"auc={metrics['auc']} knn_acc={metrics['knn_acc']:.4f}"
                        + (
                            f" ({n_no_positive} val crops have no other crop of "
                            "their identity and are not scored)"
                            if n_no_positive
                            else ""
                        )
                    )
                    wandb_logger = self._get_wandb_logger(trainer)
                    if wandb_logger is not None:
                        # The selection metrics (rank1/mAP/auc/eer/knn_acc) are logged
                        # below via pl_module.log (which Lightning forwards to wandb), so
                        # only log any EXTRA keys here to avoid double-logging the series.
                        _selected = {"rank1", "mAP", "auc", "eer", "knn_acc"}
                        log_dict = {
                            f"eval/val/{k}": v
                            for k, v in metrics.items()
                            if k not in _selected
                        }
                        if log_dict:
                            log_dict["epoch"] = trainer.current_epoch
                            wandb_logger.experiment.log(log_dict, commit=False)
                except Exception as e:
                    logger.warning(f"Embedding epoch-end evaluation failed: {e}")

        # Whether metrics were actually computed this epoch is known only on rank 0
        # (eval cadence + data availability + a possibly-swallowed exception). Broadcast
        # the flag so EVERY rank takes the SAME logging branch — mismatched ``self.log``
        # calls across ranks would hang the DDP sync barrier.
        have_metrics = bool(trainer.strategy.broadcast(metrics is not None, src=0))
        if have_metrics and metrics is not None:
            self._last_metrics = metrics

        # Log on EVERY validation epoch, not only on eval epochs. Skipping the log
        # entirely left the key absent from ``callback_metrics`` until the first
        # eval epoch, and `ModelCheckpoint` raises rather than tolerating a missing
        # monitor -- so any `eval.frequency > 1` run died at the end of epoch 0
        # (`EarlyStopping` had been given `strict=False` for this; there is no such
        # escape hatch for the checkpointer). Non-eval epochs re-log the last
        # computed values, and before the first successful eval they log NaN, which
        # `ModelCheckpoint` can never select as "best". The checkpointer is also
        # pinned to the eval cadence (`every_n_epochs`) in `model_trainer`, so a
        # carried-forward value is never what a saved "best" was chosen on.
        source = metrics if metrics is not None else self._last_metrics
        for k in ("rank1", "mAP", "auc", "eer", "knn_acc"):
            v = (
                float(source[k])
                if (source is not None and source.get(k) is not None)
                else float("nan")
            )
            v = trainer.strategy.broadcast(v, src=0)
            pl_module.log(
                f"eval/val/{k}",
                v,
                on_epoch=True,
                sync_dist=False,
                rank_zero_only=False,
            )

        pl_module._collect_val_predictions = False
        # Clear on every rank, not only rank 0, so nothing can accumulate across
        # epochs on a rank whose collections are never consumed.
        pl_module.val_predictions = []
        pl_module.val_ground_truth = []
        trainer.strategy.barrier()

    def __init__(self, eval_frequency: int = 1, knn_k: int = 7):
    """Initialize the callback.

    It logs every selection metric (rank1 / mAP / auc / eer / knn_acc); which one
    ModelCheckpoint and EarlyStopping monitor is ``trainer_config.eval.select_metric``.
    """
    super().__init__()
    self.eval_frequency = eval_frequency
    self.knn_k = knn_k
    # Last successfully computed metrics, re-logged on epochs that do not
    # evaluate so the monitored key is never ABSENT from
    # ``trainer.callback_metrics``. `ModelCheckpoint` raises
    # `MisconfigurationException: could not find the monitored key` the first
    # time it looks for a key that was never logged -- which, with
    # `eval.frequency > 1`, is the end of epoch 0.
    self._last_metrics = None
    # The val embeddings of the latest validation pass, as
    # ``{"epoch", "embedding" (N, D) float32, "label" (N,)}`` (rank 0 only). The
    # embedding scatter (`UnifiedVizCallback`) plots these instead of decoding and
    # embedding the val crops a second time.
    self.last_val_embeddings = None

    def on_validation_epoch_end(self, trainer, pl_module):
    """Compute retrieval metrics; log to callback_metrics (selection) + wandb."""
    # Nothing is collected during the sanity pass (see on_validation_epoch_start),
    # so evaluating there would only warn about an empty val set.
    should_evaluate = (
        (trainer.current_epoch + 1) % self.eval_frequency == 0
        and trainer.is_global_zero
        and not trainer.sanity_checking
    )

    collected = None
    if (
        trainer.is_global_zero
        and not trainer.sanity_checking
        and pl_module.val_predictions
        and pl_module.val_ground_truth
    ):
        # Rank 0 must reach the broadcasts below whatever happens here, or every
        # other rank waits on them; a failure only skips this epoch's eval.
        try:
            collected = self._stack_collected(
                pl_module.val_predictions, pl_module.val_ground_truth
            )
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"Could not stack the val embeddings: {e}")
        else:
            self.last_val_embeddings = {
                "epoch": trainer.current_epoch,
                "embedding": collected[0],
                "label": collected[1],
            }

    metrics = None
    if should_evaluate:
        if collected is None:
            logger.warning("No embeddings collected for embedding evaluation.")
        else:
            try:
                metrics = self._compute_metrics(*collected)
                n_no_positive = metrics.get("n_no_positive_queries", 0)
                logger.info(
                    f"Epoch {trainer.current_epoch} embedding eval: "
                    f"rank1={metrics['rank1']:.4f} mAP={metrics['mAP']:.4f} "
                    f"auc={metrics['auc']} knn_acc={metrics['knn_acc']:.4f}"
                    + (
                        f" ({n_no_positive} val crops have no other crop of "
                        "their identity and are not scored)"
                        if n_no_positive
                        else ""
                    )
                )
                wandb_logger = self._get_wandb_logger(trainer)
                if wandb_logger is not None:
                    # The selection metrics (rank1/mAP/auc/eer/knn_acc) are logged
                    # below via pl_module.log (which Lightning forwards to wandb), so
                    # only log any EXTRA keys here to avoid double-logging the series.
                    _selected = {"rank1", "mAP", "auc", "eer", "knn_acc"}
                    log_dict = {
                        f"eval/val/{k}": v
                        for k, v in metrics.items()
                        if k not in _selected
                    }
                    if log_dict:
                        log_dict["epoch"] = trainer.current_epoch
                        wandb_logger.experiment.log(log_dict, commit=False)
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"Embedding epoch-end evaluation failed: {e}")

    # Whether metrics were actually computed this epoch is known only on rank 0
    # (eval cadence + data availability + a possibly-swallowed exception). Broadcast
    # the flag so EVERY rank takes the SAME logging branch — mismatched ``self.log``
    # calls across ranks would hang the DDP sync barrier.
    have_metrics = bool(trainer.strategy.broadcast(metrics is not None, src=0))
    if have_metrics and metrics is not None:
        self._last_metrics = metrics

    # Log on EVERY validation epoch, not only on eval epochs. Skipping the log
    # entirely left the key absent from ``callback_metrics`` until the first
    # eval epoch, and `ModelCheckpoint` raises rather than tolerating a missing
    # monitor -- so any `eval.frequency > 1` run died at the end of epoch 0
    # (`EarlyStopping` had been given `strict=False` for this; there is no such
    # escape hatch for the checkpointer). Non-eval epochs re-log the last
    # computed values, and before the first successful eval they log NaN, which
    # `ModelCheckpoint` can never select as "best". The checkpointer is also
    # pinned to the eval cadence (`every_n_epochs`) in `model_trainer`, so a
    # carried-forward value is never what a saved "best" was chosen on.
    source = metrics if metrics is not None else self._last_metrics
    for k in ("rank1", "mAP", "auc", "eer", "knn_acc"):
        v = (
            float(source[k])
            if (source is not None and source.get(k) is not None)
            else float("nan")
        )
        v = trainer.strategy.broadcast(v, src=0)
        pl_module.log(
            f"eval/val/{k}",
            v,
            on_epoch=True,
            sync_dist=False,
            rank_zero_only=False,
        )

    pl_module._collect_val_predictions = False
    # Clear on every rank, not only rank 0, so nothing can accumulate across
    # epochs on a rank whose collections are never consumed.
    pl_module.val_predictions = []
    pl_module.val_ground_truth = []
    trainer.strategy.barrier()

    def on_validation_epoch_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
    """Enable per-crop embedding collection on rank 0 (skip sanity check).

    Only rank 0 computes the metrics, and every rank runs the full val set (the
    embedding val loader is not sharded), so collecting on other ranks would only
    accumulate crops that nothing reads.
    """
    if trainer.sanity_checking:
        return
    pl_module._collect_val_predictions = bool(trainer.is_global_zero)

    EncoderFreezeSchedule ¶

    Bases: Callback

    Freeze part of the model for the first unfreeze_at_step steps.

    The usual "warm up the new head on a frozen pretrained encoder, then fine-tune everything" recipe. Freezing happens in on_fit_start -- AFTER configure_optimizers -- so the frozen parameters are already in their optimizer groups (with their encoder_lr_scale / layer_decay LRs) and simply receive no gradient (Adam/AdamW skip parameters whose grad is None, weight decay included) until they are unfrozen. Do NOT combine with the backbone's freeze: true, which keeps the encoder out of the optimizer.

    Under DDP the model is wrapped before on_fit_start, so DDP has registered the frozen parameters and would wait forever for their gradients. setup therefore turns on find_unused_parameters for a DDPStrategy (and refuses an explicit find_unused_parameters=False / static_graph, or any other multi-process strategy).

    Parameters:

    Name Type Description Default
    targets Optional[list]

    Selectors of what to freeze (see sleap_nn.training.weight_transfer.resolve_selector): "encoder" (default), "embeddings", "blocks[:6]", "backbone", globs. "encoder" also keeps the encoder in eval mode while frozen (BatchNorm statistics, stochastic depth), as freeze: true does.

    		 None
    unfreeze_at_step Optional[int]

    Global step at which to unfreeze. None keeps the targets frozen for the whole run (static partial freezing).

    		 None

    class EncoderFreezeSchedule(Callback):
    """Freeze part of the model for the first ``unfreeze_at_step`` steps.

    The usual "warm up the new head on a frozen pretrained encoder, then fine-tune
    everything" recipe. Freezing happens in ``on_fit_start`` -- AFTER
    ``configure_optimizers`` -- so the frozen parameters are already in their
    optimizer groups (with their ``encoder_lr_scale`` / ``layer_decay`` LRs) and
    simply receive no gradient (Adam/AdamW skip parameters whose ``grad`` is
    ``None``, weight decay included) until they are unfrozen. Do NOT combine with
    the backbone's ``freeze: true``, which keeps the encoder out of the optimizer.

    Under DDP the model is wrapped before ``on_fit_start``, so DDP has registered
    the frozen parameters and would wait forever for their gradients. ``setup``
    therefore turns on ``find_unused_parameters`` for a ``DDPStrategy`` (and
    refuses an explicit ``find_unused_parameters=False`` / ``static_graph``, or
    any other multi-process strategy).

    Args:
        targets: Selectors of what to freeze (see
            `sleap_nn.training.weight_transfer.resolve_selector`): ``"encoder"``
            (default), ``"embeddings"``, ``"blocks[:6]"``, ``"backbone"``, globs.
            ``"encoder"`` also keeps the encoder in eval mode while frozen
            (BatchNorm statistics, stochastic depth), as ``freeze: true`` does.
        unfreeze_at_step: Global step at which to unfreeze. ``None`` keeps the
            targets frozen for the whole run (static partial freezing).
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        targets: Optional[list] = None,
        unfreeze_at_step: Optional[int] = None,
    ):
        """Initialize the schedule."""
        super().__init__()
        self.targets = list(targets or ["encoder"])
        self.unfreeze_at_step = unfreeze_at_step
        self.frozen: list = []
        self._uses_mixin = False

    def _backbone(self, pl_module):
        return getattr(getattr(pl_module, "model", None), "backbone", None)

    def setup(self, trainer, pl_module, stage):
        """Make DDP tolerate parameters that get no gradient while frozen.

        Runs before the strategy wraps the model, so the flag reaches
        ``DistributedDataParallel``.
        """
        if stage != "fit":
            return
        from lightning.pytorch.strategies import DDPStrategy, ParallelStrategy

        strategy = trainer.strategy
        if isinstance(strategy, DDPStrategy):
            ddp_kwargs = strategy._ddp_kwargs
            if ddp_kwargs.get("find_unused_parameters") is False or ddp_kwargs.get(
                "static_graph"
            ):
                message = (
                    "trainer_config.freeze_schedule freezes parameters after DDP has "
                    "wrapped the model, which needs find_unused_parameters=True and "
                    "no static_graph. Use trainer_strategy 'ddp' or "
                    "'ddp_find_unused_parameters_true'."
                )
                logger.error(message)
                raise ValueError(message)
            if not ddp_kwargs.get("find_unused_parameters"):
                ddp_kwargs["find_unused_parameters"] = True
                logger.info(
                    "EncoderFreezeSchedule: enabled DDP find_unused_parameters "
                    "(frozen parameters get no gradient)."
                )
        elif isinstance(strategy, ParallelStrategy) and strategy.world_size > 1:
            message = (
                "trainer_config.freeze_schedule supports single-device and DDP "
                f"training only, not {type(strategy).__name__}."
            )
            logger.error(message)
            raise ValueError(message)

    def on_fit_start(self, trainer, pl_module):
        """Freeze the targets (after the optimizer has been built)."""
        from sleap_nn.training.weight_transfer import (
            select_params,
            set_requires_grad,
        )

        if self.unfreeze_at_step is not None and trainer.global_step >= (
            self.unfreeze_at_step
        ):
            return  # resumed past the unfreeze point
        if not select_params(pl_module, self.targets):
            message = f"freeze_schedule targets {self.targets} match no parameter."
            logger.error(message)
            raise ValueError(message)
        backbone = self._backbone(pl_module)
        if "encoder" in self.targets and hasattr(backbone, "freeze_encoder"):
            if getattr(backbone, "freeze", False) and self.unfreeze_at_step is not None:
                message = (
                    "freeze_schedule.unfreeze_at_step is set but the backbone is "
                    "frozen by its config (freeze: true), which keeps the encoder out "
                    "of the optimizer so it would never train. Set freeze: false."
                )
                logger.error(message)
                raise ValueError(message)
            self._uses_mixin = True
        self.frozen = set_requires_grad(pl_module, self.targets, False)
        if self._uses_mixin:
            # Eval mode for the frozen encoder (BatchNorm statistics, drop path).
            backbone.freeze_encoder()
        in_optim = {
            id(p)
            for opt in trainer.optimizers
            for g in opt.param_groups
            for p in g["params"]
        }
        params = dict(pl_module.named_parameters())
        outside = [n for n in self.frozen if id(params[n]) not in in_optim]
        if outside and self.unfreeze_at_step is not None:
            logger.warning(
                f"EncoderFreezeSchedule: {len(outside)} frozen parameters are not "
                "in the optimizer and will not train after unfreezing."
            )
        logger.info(
            f"EncoderFreezeSchedule: froze {len(self.frozen)} parameter tensors "
            f"({self.targets}) until step {self.unfreeze_at_step}."
        )

    def on_train_batch_start(self, trainer, pl_module, batch, batch_idx):
        """Unfreeze once ``global_step`` reaches ``unfreeze_at_step``."""
        if (
            not self.frozen
            or self.unfreeze_at_step is None
            or trainer.global_step < self.unfreeze_at_step
        ):
            return
        if self._uses_mixin:
            self._backbone(pl_module).unfreeze_encoder()
        # Only what this callback froze (not parameters excluded on purpose).
        params = dict(pl_module.named_parameters())
        for name in self.frozen:
            params[name].requires_grad_(True)
        logger.info(
            f"EncoderFreezeSchedule: unfroze {len(self.frozen)} parameter tensors "
            f"at step {trainer.global_step}."
        )
        self.frozen = []

        ):
            message = (
                "trainer_config.freeze_schedule freezes parameters after DDP has "
                "wrapped the model, which needs find_unused_parameters=True and "
                "no static_graph. Use trainer_strategy 'ddp' or "
                "'ddp_find_unused_parameters_true'."
            )
            logger.error(message)
            raise ValueError(message)
        if not ddp_kwargs.get("find_unused_parameters"):
            ddp_kwargs["find_unused_parameters"] = True
            logger.info(
                "EncoderFreezeSchedule: enabled DDP find_unused_parameters "
                "(frozen parameters get no gradient)."
            )
    elif isinstance(strategy, ParallelStrategy) and strategy.world_size > 1:
        message = (
            "trainer_config.freeze_schedule supports single-device and DDP "
            f"training only, not {type(strategy).__name__}."
        )
        logger.error(message)
        raise ValueError(message)
